environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in namespace 'search-services' with Istio 1.20 service mesh. Sidecar injection enabled. An Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource named 'deny-cross-ns-search' is applied to the search-services namespace with spec.action DENY, matching source.notNamespaces ['search-services'] — effectively blocking all traffic originating from pods outside the search-services namespace. The frontend proxy that would relay user-controlled input lives in namespace 'web-gateway' and its requests are rejected at the Envoy sidecar level with 403 RBAC access denied before reaching the Ktor application. Only same-namespace consumers (batch indexer, health-checker) call this service, and they use hardcoded queries with no user-controlled input. Note: the AuthorizationPolicy uses workload-level attachment (not gateway-level), and the DENY rule has no 'when' conditions that could be bypassed via header manipulation since source.notNamespaces is evaluated from the mTLS peer certificate's SPIFFE identity (spiffe://cluster.local/ns/web-gateway/sa/frontend-proxy), which cannot be spoofed without compromising the Istio CA.

config.consumer_input_source: hardcoded queries from internal job scheduler, no user-facing input path
